notes.title: Global update for Sea Walker Saga demo
notes.notes:
Attention, Tokyo! We're flying to the Tokyo Game Show and bringing the full Japanese localization with us! Get ready for total immersion: build your floating island, battle pirates, and set off on adventures in maximum comfort!

What's new in the demo version?
Redesigned inventory interface

Added mocap to cutscenes

Added artificial intelligence to pirates and islands

Improved graphics quality

Optimization work

Added Japanese localization

Added German localization

Added Turkish localization



But this is just the beginning! We look forward to meeting players from around the world who will appreciate the exciting Water World-inspired storyline and unique mechanics of Sea Walker Saga. Get ready for a great voyage!

notes.title: Sea Walker Saga demo update
notes.notes:
Friends, listening to your feedback, we decided to finalize the demo version! You may have already noticed new colorful covers from our artist, but the project has been transformed not only visually

The following fixes are already available:

 Fixed an old critical bug on Archipelago related to the controller and interaction
 Added a new tutorial system
 Removed unnecessary details from scenes
 Fixed environment lodes
 Added loading icon on the loading screen
 Minor fixes with character getting stuck between islands on Archipelago
 Added new textures to islands
 Updated borders with colliders on Marco Island
 Improved vegetation shaders: notice by grass and FPS
 Redesigned materials on all characters: now there is no pronounced blue edge on clothes and skin
 Changed final cutscene
 Added a couple of new auxiliary hints
 Other small edits to make the game more comfortable

Enjoy your journey across the vast seas in search of the mythical continent!
